facts.text: Guro Industrial Complex, founded in 1967 in Guro 3‑dong, was Korea’s first industrial zone and a key driver of the 1970s export boom.
The complex evolved into the Guro Digital Industrial Complex, now a leading IT hub that once accounted for 10 % of national exports.
In 2007, Guro hosted an international e‑participation forum that produced the Guro Declaration, a landmark for global e‑government cooperation.
Sindorim Station, just north of Guro, handles over 320,000 passengers daily, making it one of Seoul’s busiest transfer points.
Guro’s wrestling team earned a silver medal at the Olympics and a gold at the Asian Games, showcasing the district’s athletic prowess.
The Tomb of Princess Jeongseon in Gung‑dong houses her grave and those of her husband Kwon Dae‑im, reflecting Guro’s royal heritage.
